networking_specs.highlight: Felix demoed unified P2P networking spec repo merging devp2p (EL) and consensus-specs (CL) networking into one place
Repo introduces legacy/current/experimental versioning; full reified specs per version; EIP-named draft files for in-progress proposals
CL networking spec compiled to single up-to-date document (v6 at Gloas); fork-based versioning retained; gossip validation functions stay in consensus-specs
Planned additions: Waggle and zkast under new 'broadcast' directory; QUIC transport spec; libp2p adapter spec
jxs: Lodestar drove QUIC adoption but has no plans to deprecate TCP; cayman: QUIC-only vision appealing long-term; Silver is QUIC-only

webtx_protocol.highlight: Geth (Bosul): WebTX — new sub-protocol allowing browsers to submit transactions directly to EL P2P network via WebTransport/QUIC, bypassing RPC
ENR extended with certificate hash field (QH); two-week rotation with advance announcement; identity proof via signed challenge on session open
Browser connections limited: 10s lifetime, disconnect after first message, IP-based rate limiting on invalid transactions
Protocol is write-only (transaction submit + result response); peer exchange planned; onion routing considered long-term
WebTX merged in Geth; browser→node connections testable on mainnet today; spec PR: ethereum/devp2p#276

xmss_signature_broadcast_simulations.highlight: Kamil ran gossip-sub simulations (~3,700 nodes, 32K validators) for XMSS/large-signature attestation propagation
Reducing gossip-sub mesh degree from 8→4 cuts average duplicates from 4→2.5 with no latency regression
Staggered push approach (hash peer IDs + message to assign pusher/waiter role) reduces duplicates to ~1.6; propagation latency unchanged or improved
ProbeLab (Mikel): simulations reflect happy path only; adversarial/churn scenarios (eclipse, delayed forwarding) should be included in roadmap
cayman: simulations should include EIP-7870 bandwidth-bound nodes; bad numbers justify updating bandwidth assumptions
